query: Do SC and ST applicants have to pay fees for Assam government exams?
context:
[DOC-AS-SCST-001] Section: Section 2
Text: Fees, if any, prescribed for any examinations for selection to any service or posts shall be exempted in case of candidates belonging to the Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes.
Hash: 3f01d05729f8d7adc36b1912e628e384f4ca38f6ce55e2b7820d1de82554ca6e
answer: No. Under Section 2 of the Assam Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes (Reservation of Vacancies in Services and Posts) (Amendment) Act, 2024 (Assam Act No. XXXI of 2024), fees prescribed for any examination for selection to any service or posts are completely exempted for SC and ST candidates.
citations: Assam Act No. XXXI of 2024, Section 2, Page 2 (Assam Gazette Extraordinary No. 530, 25th October 2024)

query: Can an Assam government department split a procurement order to avoid Finance Department approval?
context:
[DOC-AS-PROC-001] Section: Rule 3
Text: Splitting of procurement requirements to avoid sanction of higher authority is strictly prohibited.
Hash: f869077b0a598191bf34daf0f159e085181328178bbe583d98c7b639ea3825fb
answer: No. Under Rule 3 of the Assam Public Procurement Rules, 2020, procuring entities must estimate costs objectively, and splitting procurement requirements to avoid sanction from a higher competent authority is strictly prohibited.
